Name: Normal Block
Desc: [Does not grant enhancements] Disappears once cleared, rawr.

Name: Red Wave Cube
Desc: Shrinks by one unit after a clear, rawr!

Name: Green Wave Cube
Desc: Produces a Normal Cube after a clear, rawr!

Name: Wave Cube
Desc: Disappears and requests backup after three clears. Removes all cubes above once, rawr!

Name: Undercurrent Cube
Desc: When swiped, clears all cubes in the same row in the direction of the swipe. It disappears after being swiped or cleared 3 times.
